documents.content:
- 03:38 – Security guard M. Ibrahim observes suspicious movement near the north-west fence line on CCTV monitor and in person during patrol round.

- 03:45 – Guard calls site supervisor (A. Bello) and then the police emergency line.

| Battery Cabinet BB-2 lock | Battery bank area, cabinet 2 | Padlock cut. Cabinet door opened. No signs of forced entry beyond lock. | Lock replaced (new key). Cabinet contents verified. |
| CCTV camera CAM-07 | North-west perimeter pole | Camera operational. Footage captured. | Footage saved to DVR and copied to external drive for police. |
| Inverter INV-03 enclosure | Inverter platform | Scratches on enclosure door near handle. No damage to lock or seals. | No action required. |

---

**Inventory Verification (Battery Cabinet BB-2):**

After the lock was cut, a full inventory of BB-2 was conducted. All items accounted for. No loss.

- Battery modules: 12 (all present, serial numbers recorded)
- Battery management system (BMS) unit: 1, present
- DC breakers: 2, present
- Temperature sensors: 3, present
- Cabling and connectors: intact

**Note:** The cabinet door was open for approximately 3.5 hours between the incident and the inventory check. Battery temperatures were checked after re-locking. All cells normal (max 33°C). No performance impact expected.

---

**Witness Statement – M. Ibrahim (Security Guard):**

Kano Solar Farm incident_date is 2026-08-12. Record status: historical.

*Summary recorded by T. Okafor at 08:45. Full written statement signed and submitted to police.*

"I was doing my 03:30 patrol round. I came from the east side, walking along the fence line. When I got near the north-west corner, I saw two men at the fence. One was crouching down, cutting the wire with a tool – looked like bolt cutters. The other one was standing, watching the road. They had a torch but it was off. I shouted at them and called on the radio. They ran off into the bush towards the main road. I didn't see their faces clearly. One was wearing a blue shirt, the other a dark red one. They didn't take anything because I got there before they could get through. I stayed at the spot until the police came."

---

**Witness Statement – A. Bello (Site Supervisor, phone call at 03:45):**

*Summary recorded by T. Okafor at 09:10.*

"I got the call from Musa at 03:45. He was calm, said two men had run off. I told him to stay at the spot and not touch anything. I called the manager and then I came in early, got here around 04:30. I checked the fence with Musa and saw the cut. We didn't go into the battery area until the police arrived. The police took photos and then we did the lock check."

5. **Site Security Review:** Guard patrol schedule remains unchanged. Additional floodlight near the north-west corner has been requested. **Follow-up task for site manager.**

**Monthly Summary – August 2026**

**1. Overview**

August was a busy month for the Kano site. The team completed the scheduled preventive maintenance on all three inverter houses, performed two full rounds of panel cleaning (arrays 1, 2, 4, 6A, 6B, 6C), and responded to three fault callouts. One major fault remains open: the degraded panel on String C2 (fault #M-2026-0813-01) awaiting replacement from Lagos. All other outstanding items from July were closed by mid-month.

**3. Outstanding Tasks (as of 31/08/2026)**

1. **String C2 panel replacement** – Fault #M-2026-0813-01. Panel serial #KSF-2024-1187 showing 40% reduced output. Ordered from Lagos on 13/08. Delivery window 5–7 days, but supply delays due to port clearance. Expected arrival now 03/09. Site to run C2 at reduced output until then; monitoring twice daily (morning and evening peak). No critical risk, but if output drops below 4.5 A, isolate string and report.

2. **Old cooling fan disposal** – Logged for disposal on 13/08. Still in store room. To be added to next disposal batch (end of September).

3. **Specific gravity recheck** – B2 cells 7 and 12 topped up on 13/08. Recheck due 13/09 (one month interval).

4. **Stock reorder – distilled water** – Used 4L in August. Reorder level is 10L. Current stock 6L. Raise purchase request before 15/09.

5. **IV curve tracer calibration** – Due for annual calibration in September. Contact metrology service in Abuja to schedule.

**4. Planning Notes – September 2026**

- **Week 1 (01–05 Sep):** Focus on C2 panel replacement when delivery arrives. Also close out any remaining August paperwork. Night guard reported a small animal (likely civet) near B2 battery bank on 30/08 – no damage, but check for chew marks on cables during next PM.
- **Week 2 (08–12 Sep):** Preventive maintenance on inverter houses 2 and 3. Inspect all DC isolators and torque-check busbar connections. This is the last PM round before the harmattan season begins.
- **Week 3 (15–19 Sep):** Quarterly thermographic scan of all combiner boxes. Contractor booked for Wednesday 16/09. Ensure access paths are clear.
- **Week 4 (22–26 Sep):** Full string current test on all arrays. Compare with August baseline. Also check all panel mounting clamps – two reports of loose clamps from neighbouring sites in the region due to wind.
- **End of month:** Submit September summary and stock take. Plan for October: pre-harmattan cleaning of all arrays, check all seals on inverter enclosures.

**6. Staff Notes**

- New safety harnesses arrived on 25/08. All six harnesses inspected and tagged.
- Leave approved for one technician from 07–11 Sep. Workload adjusted; no impact on PM schedule.

**7. Weather and Site Conditions**

- August rainfall was above average – 14 rain days. No flooding on site, but access road to the north gate had soft patches. Grader hired on 19/08 to level. Monitor after next heavy rain.
- Humidity levels high; condensation observed on inverter house roofs. Silica gel packs replaced in all control cabinets on 21/08.
